import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
src = Path.cwd()
N, B, Q, S, H = chr(10), chr(92), chr(34), chr(39), '[0-9a-f]'
dashed = H + '{8}-' + H + '{4}-' + H + '{4}-' + H + '{4}-' + H + '{12}'
bad = {
    'bypass_import.py': 'from uuid import UUID' + N + 'def ok(value):' + N + '    return UUID(value).version in range(1, 9)' + N,
    'bypass_alias.py': 'import uuid as u' + N + 'def ok(value):' + N + '    return u.UUID(value).int != 0' + N,
    'bypass_getattr.py': 'import uuid' + N + 'PARSE = getattr(uuid, ' + repr('UUID') + ')' + N,
    'bypass_escaped.py': 'import re' + N + 'RID = re.compile(' + repr(dashed.replace('-', B + '-')) + ')' + N,
    'bypass_concat.py': 'import re' + N + 'HEXC = ' + repr(H) + N + 'RID = re.compile(HEXC + ' + repr('{8}-') + ' + HEXC + ' + repr('{4}-') + ' + HEXC + ' + repr('{4}') + ')' + N,
    'bypass_fstring.py': 'import re' + N + 'HEXC = ' + repr(H) + N + 'RID = re.compile(f' + repr('{HEXC}{{8}}-{HEXC}{{4}}-{HEXC}{{4}}') + ')' + N,
    'lib/ids.py': 'import re' + N + 'RID = re.compile(' + repr('^[0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9A-F]{3}-[89AB][0-9A-F]{3}-[0-9A-F]{12}$') + ')' + N,
    'lib/run_id.py': 'import re' + N + 'RID = re.compile(' + repr(dashed) + ')' + N,
    'observe_output.py': (src / 'scripts/observe_output.py').read_text().replace('CODEX_THREAD_ID_RE', 'THREAD_RE'),
    'bypass.sh': '#!/usr/bin/env bash' + N + 'grep -Eq ' + S + '^' + dashed.replace('-', B + '-') + S + ' <<<' + Q + '$1' + Q + N,
    'bypass_xdigit.sh': '#!/usr/bin/env bash' + N + 'grep -Eq ' + S + '[[:xdigit:]]{8}-[[:xdigit:]]{4}' + S + ' <<<x' + N,
}
ok = {
    'gen_ok.py': 'import re, uuid' + N + 'TOKEN = str(uuid.uuid4())' + N + 'LOC = re.compile(' + repr('run_id=(' + B + 'S+)') + ')' + N + 'SHA = re.compile(' + repr(H + '{64}') + ')' + N,
    'gen_ok.sh': '#!/usr/bin/env bash' + N + 'RUN_ID=' + Q + '$(python3 -c ' + S + 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())' + S + ')' + Q + N,
}
def run(tree):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tests/test-run-id.py', 'RunIdTests.test_no_script_parses_run_ids_itself'], cwd=tree, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'), capture_output=True, text=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    clean = Path(tmp, 'clean')
    shutil.copytree(src / 'scripts', clean / 'scripts', ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__'))
    (clean / 'tests').mkdir()
    shutil.copy2(src / 'tests/test-run-id.py', clean / 'tests/test-run-id.py')
    r = run(clean)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[-1500:]
    cases = [(k, v, 1) for k, v in bad.items()] + [(k, v, 0) for k, v in ok.items()]
    for i, (rel, text, want) in enumerate(cases):
        tree = Path(tmp, 't%d' % i)
        shutil.copytree(clean, tree)
        p = tree / 'scripts' / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(text)
        r = run(tree)
        if want:
            assert r.returncode != 0 and rel in r.stderr, (rel, r.returncode, r.stderr[-800:])
        else:
            assert r.returncode == 0, (rel, r.stderr[-800:])
print('ok')
